Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by having the class 'Foo' implement 'Comparable<Bar>' instead of 'Comparable<Foo>'. This violates the symmetry contract of the compareTo method, as 'x.compareTo(y) == -y.compareTo(x)' cannot be guaranteed when x and y are of different types.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with a Foo and a Bar object, which internally calls the compareTo method of Foo with a Bar object, violating the ComparableType rule.
